svg.aria-label: Gerver's sofa G in blue. Its niche is the region strictly under the orange curve Γ, made of the curves D and B and the rotation path between them; Γ stays below height 0.665, under the dashed line at height one, and the dashed rectangle from a to b lies in the cap. Every point p of Γ is the limit of the interior points just above it
